note: The kinds of records under their types (ADR 0029, docs/plan-kinds.md). A kind that is no longer wanted is marked retired, never deleted. The first list of 2026-11-28, widened the same day while the whole library was classified.

kinds.label: War
kinds.meaning: An armed struggle between powers over a span of time, of history or of a story.

kinds.label: Battle
kinds.meaning: One fight of armies at one place, often part of a war.

kinds.label: Siege
kinds.meaning: The surrounding of a city or a stronghold to take it.

kinds.label: Revolt
kinds.meaning: A rising against a ruler or a state.

kinds.label: Conquest
kinds.meaning: The taking of a land or a city by force.

kinds.label: Treaty
kinds.meaning: An agreement between powers: a peace, an alliance, a border.

kinds.label: Founding
kinds.meaning: The beginning of a city, a state, a dynasty or an institution.

kinds.label: Natural event
kinds.meaning: Something nature does that marks the time and the people: a drought, a flood, an earthquake.

kinds.label: Drought
kinds.meaning: A long time without enough rain.

kinds.label: Flood
kinds.meaning: Water that rises over the land.

kinds.label: Earthquake
kinds.meaning: A shaking of the earth.

kinds.label: Frost
kinds.meaning: A cold that kills crops or people: a hard winter, a late frost.

kinds.label: Famine
kinds.meaning: A time when there is not enough food.

kinds.label: Epidemic
kinds.meaning: A disease that spreads among many people.

kinds.label: Religious event
kinds.meaning: Something that happened in a faith: a council, a reform, a conversion.

kinds.label: Building
kinds.meaning: The making of a building or a work of building: a palace, a wall, a canal.

kinds.label: Discovery
kinds.meaning: A finding of knowledge or of a place.

kinds.label: Death
kinds.meaning: The death of somebody, as an event of its own.

kinds.label: Accession
kinds.meaning: The coming of a ruler to the throne.

kinds.label: Political
kinds.meaning: A person known for a part in power and the state.

kinds.label: Ruler
kinds.meaning: A person who ruled: a king, a queen, an emperor, a caliph.

kinds.label: Statesman
kinds.meaning: A person who served a state: a vizier, a minister, an envoy.

kinds.label: General
kinds.meaning: A person who led armies.

kinds.label: Religious
kinds.meaning: A person known for a part in a faith: a prophet, a priest, a saint, a scholar of a faith.

kinds.label: Literary
kinds.meaning: A person known for writing.

kinds.label: Poet
kinds.meaning: A person who wrote poems.

kinds.label: Historian
kinds.meaning: A person who wrote history.

kinds.label: Scientific
kinds.meaning: A person known for knowledge of nature, numbers or medicine.

kinds.label: Artistic
kinds.meaning: A person known for making art: painting, music, building, calligraphy.

kinds.label: Philosopher
kinds.meaning: A person known for thought about being, knowing and living.

kinds.label: Hero
kinds.meaning: A character of a story known for deeds of strength and courage.

kinds.label: King
kinds.meaning: A character of a story who rules.

kinds.label: Demon
kinds.meaning: A being of a story of evil and harm: a div.

kinds.label: Divine being
kinds.meaning: A being of a story of the other world: a god, an angel, a yazata.

kinds.label: Creature
kinds.meaning: A creature of a story that is not of this world: a Simorgh, a dragon.

kinds.label: City
kinds.meaning: A town or a city.

kinds.label: Capital
kinds.meaning: A city from which a land was ruled.

kinds.label: Battlefield
kinds.meaning: A place where battles were fought.

kinds.label: Sanctuary
kinds.meaning: A holy place: a temple, a fire temple, a shrine.

kinds.label: River
kinds.meaning: A river or its valley.

kinds.label: Mountain
kinds.meaning: A mountain or a range of mountains.

kinds.label: Poem
kinds.meaning: A work of poetry.

kinds.label: Work of history
kinds.meaning: A work that tells history: a chronicle, a history.

kinds.label: Inscription
kinds.meaning: Words cut or pressed into stone, clay or metal.

kinds.label: Monument
kinds.meaning: A building or a work that was made to be remembered.

kinds.label: Law and reform
kinds.meaning: A law, an edict, a code or a reform of the state.

kinds.label: Journey and embassy
kinds.meaning: A journey to far lands, a pilgrimage or an embassy.

kinds.label: Fall of a state
kinds.meaning: The end of a state, an empire or a ruling house.

kinds.label: Writing of a work
kinds.meaning: The writing, the completion or a gathering for the making of a work.

kinds.label: Ceremony
kinds.meaning: A wedding, a coronation or another ceremony.

kinds.label: Disaster
kinds.meaning: A great fire or another catastrophe that nature did not bring.

kinds.label: Rule of a house
kinds.meaning: A period named after the house or the state that ruled.

kinds.label: Age of history
kinds.meaning: A period historians name for a land: a kingdom, an intermediate period, a republic.

kinds.label: Ancient culture
kinds.meaning: A culture known from what archaeologists dig up, before or beside written history.

kinds.label: Royal house
kinds.meaning: A member of a ruling house who did not rule: a queen, a consort, a prince, a princess.

kinds.label: Rebel
kinds.meaning: A person who led a revolt against a ruler or a state.

kinds.label: Sage
kinds.meaning: A character of a story known for wisdom, faith or foresight: a mobad, a hermit, a reader of the stars.

kinds.label: Sorcerer
kinds.meaning: A character of a story who works magic: a sorcerer, a witch.

kinds.label: Noble
kinds.meaning: A lord, a counsellor or an envoy of a court in a story.

kinds.label: Of the people
kinds.meaning: A character who is neither a ruler nor a champion: a servant, a keeper, a craftsman, a messenger.

kinds.label: Steed
kinds.meaning: A horse of a story with a name and a part of its own.

kinds.label: Story of a reign
kinds.meaning: A section of a work on the reign of one king.

kinds.label: War story
kinds.meaning: A story told mostly through war and battle.

kinds.label: Tale of a hero
kinds.meaning: A story of a hero's trials, labours and growing up.

kinds.label: Love story
kinds.meaning: A story of love and of what lovers go through.

kinds.label: Tragedy
kinds.meaning: A story that ends in the death or the ruin of its heroes.

kinds.label: Tale of the court
kinds.meaning: A story of wisdom, counsel and games at a king's court.

kinds.label: Teaching
kinds.meaning: A work of thought or of a faith: sayings, a scripture, a book on how to live.

kinds.label: Treatise
kinds.meaning: A work of knowledge: medicine, the stars, the art of war, lands and peoples.

kinds.label: Edition
kinds.meaning: A printed edition of a work, prepared by scholars.

kinds.label: Manuscript
kinds.meaning: A handwritten copy of a work.

kinds.label: Document
kinds.meaning: A written decree, a record, a letter or a testimony.

kinds.label: Weapon
kinds.meaning: A weapon: a mace, a sword, an arrow.

kinds.label: Keepsake
kinds.meaning: A ring, a token or a gift kept as a sign.

kinds.label: Wondrous thing
kinds.meaning: A thing of a story with a power not of this world.

kinds.label: Banner
kinds.meaning: A banner or another sign of a people or a cause.

kinds.label: Prison
kinds.meaning: A pit, a cell or another place where someone is held captive.

kinds.label: Fortress
kinds.meaning: A castle or a stronghold.

kinds.label: Camp
kinds.meaning: The encampment of an army.

kinds.label: Sea or lake
kinds.meaning: A sea, a lake or another great water.

kinds.label: Open land
kinds.meaning: A plain, a meadow, a forest or a pass.

kinds.label: Land
kinds.meaning: A land or a country as a stretch of the earth.

kinds.label: State
kinds.meaning: A kingdom, a republic or an empire as a power.

kinds.label: Throne
kinds.meaning: The office of a ruler: a kingship, an imperial throne, a caliphate, an emirate.

kinds.label: Office of state
kinds.meaning: An office of government under the ruler or of a republic: a consul, a governor.

kinds.label: Office of a faith
kinds.meaning: An office held in a faith: the leadership of believers, a priesthood.

kinds.label: Ruling house
kinds.meaning: A house of kings, emperors or governors.

kinds.label: House of legend
kinds.meaning: A house of the epic or of tradition, not of recorded history.

kinds.label: House of heroes
kinds.meaning: A house of champions of a story.

kinds.label: Council
kinds.meaning: A body of people who deliberate and decide: a senate.

kinds.label: Research
kinds.meaning: A body that studies and discovers: an institute, a research society.

kinds.label: University
kinds.meaning: A university or a school of higher learning.

kinds.label: Library
kinds.meaning: A library that keeps books and manuscripts.

kinds.label: Museum
kinds.meaning: A museum that keeps and shows works of the past.

kinds.label: Idea
kinds.meaning: An idea of the state, of a faith or of thought.

kinds.label: Topic
kinds.meaning: A subject that brings the records of a collection together.
